# 👋 Welcome

Hi, I'm **Luoyan Zhang**, a graduate student at Boston University studying *Applied Business Analytics*. With a background in Accounting, Finance, and Management from the University of Nottingham, I am passionate about data, strategy, and the evolving landscape of business analytics.

This website is a collection of my academic and professional work, including selected projects, my resume, and contact information. Feel free to explore and connect with me!
